iterations.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/order-fulfillment">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Customer order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentFailure" name="Payment failure notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BackorderDelay" name="Back-order delay notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShippingConfirmation" name="Shipping confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Successful delivery confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FeedbackEmail" name="Feedback follow-up email"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DeliveryIssue" name="Delivery issue report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ReturnLabel" name="Return shipping label"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ReturnedItems" name="Returned items"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OrderFulfillment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="E-commerce company" processRef="Process_OrderFulfillment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Places order" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentFailure" name="Payment failure notification" sourceRef="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_PaymentFailure"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BackorderDelay" name="Back-order delay notification" sourceRef="Task_InformBackorderDelay" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_BackorderDelay"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShippingConfirmation" name="Shipping confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_ShippingConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Successful delivery confirmation" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Event_DeliveryConfirmed" messageRef="Message_DeliveryConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Feedback follow-up email" sourceRef="Task_SendFeedbackEmail" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_FeedbackEmail"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DeliveryIssue" name="Delivery issue report" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_DeliveryIssue" messageRef="Message_DeliveryIssue"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReturnLabel" name="Return shipping label" sourceRef="Task_SendReturnLabel" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_ReturnLabel"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReturnedItems" name="Returned items" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems" messageRef="Message_ReturnedItems"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderReceived" name="Order placed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OrderReceived" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order details"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessPayment" name="Process payment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentResult" name="Payment successful?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure" name="Notify customer of payment failure" messageRef="Message_PaymentFailure"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PaymentFailed" name="Payment failed"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check stock availability"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockAvailability" name="Items in stock?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InitiateBackorder" name="Initiate back-order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InformBackorderDelay" name="Inform customer of delay" messageRef="Message_BackorderDelay"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveBackorder" name="Receive back-order and make items available"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockMerge" name="Continue with available items"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PickItems" name="Pick items from warehouse"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_QualityControl" name="Check item quality"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackageItems" name="Package items"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GiftWrap" name="Gift wrapping requested?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiftWrap" name="Gift-wrap items"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GiftWrapMerge" name="Continue packaging"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare package and shipping documents"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InternationalOrder" name="International order?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareShippingDocuments" name="Prepare shipping documents and labels"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareCustomsDocuments" name="Prepare customs documentation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomsMerge" name="Shipping documents ready"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Packaging and documents ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DispatchOrder" name="Dispatch order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PostDispatchSplit" name="Complete post-dispatch actions"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" name="Send shipping confirmation" messageRef="Message_ShippingConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update inventory levels"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PostDispatchJoin" name="Post-dispatch actions complete"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DeliveryConfirmed" name="Successful delivery confirmed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DeliveryConfirmed" messageRef="Message_DeliveryConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFeedbackEmail" name="Send feedback follow-up email" messageRef="Message_FeedbackEmail"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FulfillmentComplete" name="Fulfillment complete"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Returns" name="Process return" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_DeliveryIssue" name="Customer reports delivery issue" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DeliveryIssue" messageRef="Message_DeliveryIssue"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReturnLabel" name="Send return shipping label" messageRef="Message_ReturnLabel"/>
      <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems" name="Receive returned items" messageRef="Message_ReturnedItems"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_InspectReturnedItems" name="Inspect returned items"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundOrReplacement" name="Refund or replacement?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessRefund" name="Process refund"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessReplacement" name="Process replacement"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RefundProcessed" name="Refund processed"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReplacementProcessed" name="Replacement processed"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_Start_SendLabel" sourceRef="StartEvent_DeliveryIssue" targetRef="Task_SendReturnLabel"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_SendLabel_ReceiveItems" sourceRef="Task_SendReturnLabel" targetRef="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_ReceiveItems_Inspect" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems" targetRef="Task_InspectReturnedItems"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_Inspect_Decision" sourceRef="Task_InspectReturnedItems" targetRef="Gateway_RefundOrReplacement"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_Refund" name="Refund" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundOrReplacement" targetRef="Task_ProcessRefund">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">refundSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_Replacement" name="Replacement" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundOrReplacement" targetRef="Task_ProcessReplacement" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_Refund_End" sourceRef="Task_ProcessRefund" targetRef="EndEvent_RefundProcessed"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_Replacement_End" sourceRef="Task_ProcessReplacement" targetRef="EndEvent_ReplacementProcessed"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_Record" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_Payment" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_ProcessPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_Decision" sourceRef="Task_ProcessPayment" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_Success" name="Successful payment" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentResult" targetRef="Task_CheckStock">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">paymentSuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_Failure" name="Payment failed" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentResult" targetRef="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyPaymentFailure_End" sourceRef="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure" targetRef="EndEvent_PaymentFailed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckStock_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_StockAvailability"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_Available" name="In stock" sourceRef="Gateway_StockAvailability" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">allItemsAvailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_Backorder" name="Out of stock" sourceRef="Gateway_StockAvailability" targetRef="Task_InitiateBackorder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Initiate_Inform" sourceRef="Task_InitiateBackorder" targetRef="Task_InformBackorderDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inform_ReceiveBackorder" sourceRef="Task_InformBackorderDelay" targetRef="Task_ReceiveBackorder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveBackorder_StockMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveBackorder" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockMerge_Pick" sourceRef="Gateway_StockMerge" targetRef="Task_PickItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Pick_Quality" sourceRef="Task_PickItems" targetRef="Task_QualityControl"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Quality_GiftDecision" sourceRef="Task_QualityControl" targetRef="Gateway_GiftWrap"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GiftWrap_Yes" name="Requested" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftWrap" targetRef="Task_GiftWrap">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">giftWrappingRequested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GiftWrap_No" name="Not requested" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftWrap" targetRef="Gateway_GiftWrapMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GiftWrap_Task_Merge" sourceRef="Task_GiftWrap" targetRef="Gateway_GiftWrapMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GiftWrapMerge_PrepSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftWrapMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepSplit_Package" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PackageItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Package_PrepJoin" sourceRef="Task_PackageItems" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepSplit_ShippingDocs" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShippingDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShippingDocs_International" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShippingDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_InternationalOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_International_Yes" name="International" sourceRef="Gateway_InternationalOrder" targetRef="Task_PrepareCustomsDocuments">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">internationalOrder</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_International_No" name="Domestic" sourceRef="Gateway_InternationalOrder" targetRef="Gateway_CustomsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customs_Merge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareCustomsDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_CustomsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomsMerge_PrepJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomsMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationJoin_Dispatch" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_DispatchOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Dispatch_PostSplit" sourceRef="Task_DispatchOrder" targetRef="Gateway_PostDispatchSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostSplit_Confirmation" sourceRef="Gateway_PostDispatchSplit" targetRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostSplit_Inventory" sourceRef="Gateway_PostDispatchSplit" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_PostJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_PostDispatchJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inventory_PostJoin" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Gateway_PostDispatchJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostJoin_Delivery" sourceRef="Gateway_PostDispatchJoin" targetRef="Event_DeliveryConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Delivery_Feedback" sourceRef="Event_DeliveryConfirmed" targetRef="Task_SendFeedbackEmail"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_End" sourceRef="Task_SendFeedbackEmail" targetRef="EndEvent_FulfillmentComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
